common.per_fold: one model per inner fold, trained on that fold's fitting_rows ONLY (never seen-val, unseen-val or outer-exclusion rows); features for that fold's evaluation rows are extracted from that fold's model
common.downstream: the unchanged D1 recipe (synth_composition, fuse 1.0, normalise) on the fold's fine-tuned features, so only the representation changes
common.loss: CE(crop) + CE(disease) on linear heads over the CLIP image embedding, composition-balanced sampling
common.optimiser: AdamW, lr 1e-5 backbone / 1e-3 heads, weight decay 0.05, cosine schedule, 1 warm-up epoch, AMP fp16, batch 32
common.no_early_stopping: fixed epochs; no validation-based stopping or checkpoint choice
common.eval_views: centre + h-flip of the deterministic CLIP transform, identical to the frozen features
common.weights: local ViT-L-14.pt / convnext_base-6075fbad.pth only; nothing downloaded
